requirement.description: The Layout class has a duplicate __int__ method definition, causing TypeError when trying to interpret layout objects as integers. This affects StructLayout and UnionLayout classes that inherit from Layout.
requirement.contract: The Layout class should have a single __int__ method that returns the size of the layout. The method should be removed from the child classes (StructLayout, UnionLayout) to avoid duplication.

requirement.description: The SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes reference IOSlice but it's not imported or defined, causing NameError when trying to use I/O slicing operations.
requirement.contract: The IOSlice class should be imported from amaranth.hdl._ast and used consistently in SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes for proper slicing operations.

requirement.description: Missing Direction aliases (Input, Output, Bidir) that are expected by various tests, causing AttributeError when accessing these attributes.
requirement.contract: Add proper Direction aliases to match expected test behavior by mapping to Direction.FANIN, Direction.FANOUT, and Direction.NONE respectively.

requirement.description: StructLayout and UnionLayout classes have redundant __int__ method definitions that conflict with the parent Layout class's implementation.
requirement.contract: Remove the duplicate __int__ method definitions from StructLayout and UnionLayout classes to ensure consistent behavior and avoid conflicts.

requirement.description: The IOPort class has an issue with __int__ method that should return the width of the I/O port for proper integer conversion.
requirement.contract: Add a proper __int__ method to the IOPort class that returns its width to resolve conversion issues with I/O ports.
requirement.acceptance: tests that involve I/O port integer conversion or comparison
